title: Edition B08 (Duo)
caption: DREW: "The Fed remains on hold in concept, tightening in the minutes."
tv: GLOBAL BOND YIELDS SOAR; RATE HIKE BETS RISE
tvPicture: a stone government building with tall columns.
board: PAUSE HOUR 4-7 / EVERY POUR $14, UNCHANGED / THREE OF TWELVE STAFF WANT $15
action: Drew, deadpan, holds his martini perfectly still; Barclay, uneasy, watches the ice shift in his old fashioned; Abby, grinning, holds up three fingers to the pair as if polling the room.
turn: Status Report - the institution's stated posture and its own paperwork, filed side by side

title: Edition A07 (Trio)
caption: DREW: "Energy independence remains ours in the ground and theirs at the pump."
tv: CRUDE TOPS $95 AFTER STRAIT OF HORMUZ ATTACKS
tvPicture: An oil pumpjack nodding alone in a flat field under a wide sky.
board: WEST TEXAS SOUR $14 / PERSIAN GULF SOUR $14 / PRICE LIST PRINTED ABROAD
action: Drew, deadpan, bill slightly parted, turns his martini a quarter-turn by the stem as he delivers the verdict; Barclay, earnest, pats his jacket for his wallet without noticing he is doing it, his old fashioned untouched on its coaster.
turn: STATUS REPORT - two parallel clauses, the first the policy and the second the receipt; the contradiction sits in the gap between them.

title: Edition B03 (Duo)
caption: BARCLAY: "I'm not chasing this dip, Drew. I only bought the first two."
tv: CHIP STOCKS DROP AGAIN; STRATEGISTS SAY BUY WEAKNESS
tvPicture: a single falling line on a blank chart, axes bare
board: RESOLVED TO SIT OUT: 3 / ACTUALLY SAT OUT: 0
action: Barclay, sincere, lifts his old fashioned as if toasting his own restraint; Drew, one eyebrow up, sips his martini; Abby, chuckling, tops off Barclay's water glass.
turn: UNNOTICED CONTRADICTION - the accounting (two already) refutes the abstention in the same breath.

title: Edition B09 (Duo)
caption: DREW: "Our tariff on Taiwan works out to a cover charge at the only bar in town."
tv: NEW U.S. TARIFFS TARGET CHIPS FROM CHINA AND TAIWAN
tvPicture: a single computer chip, close up, on a dark background
board: ADMISSION 41% / PAYABLE BY THE GUEST / SECOND DOOR: NONE
action: Drew, bill parted, delivers it to his martini without looking up; Barclay, brows raised, holds his old fashioned an inch off its coaster; Abby, beaming, scoops fresh ice from the well into a rocks glass behind the bar.
turn: THEFT - a tariff on the sole supplier refiled as a cover charge we pay to get in anyway.

title: Edition B05 (Duo)
caption: BARCLAY: "I bought AI infrastructure for the future. Today I'd settle for a hard hat."
tv: DATA-CENTER BUILDOUT NAMES FALL ON CHIP TARIFFS
tvPicture: a long windowless warehouse with rows of rooftop cooling fans
board: THE DATA CENTER $22 / CHIPS SOLD SEPARATELY / POWER NOT INCLUDED
action: Barclay, hopeful, cradles his old fashioned in both hands; Drew, dry, regards him sidelong over the martini; Abby, laughing at the line, slides the nut bowl across the marble to Barclay.
turn: DOWNGRADED WANT - the future swapped for the smallest physical thing infrastructure should have come with.

title: Edition A03 (Trio)
caption: DREW: "The Dow did its whole September on the first, so the other twenty-nine days are optional."
tv: STOCKS OPEN SEPTEMBER LOWER; DOW FALLS 0.8%
tvPicture: a bronze bull statue on a cobblestone street.
board: THE WORST MONTH $30 / DELIVERED TUESDAY, ALL OF IT / NO REFILLS UNTIL OCTOBER
action: Drew, serene, folds his napkin and lays it beside his martini as though closing a ledger; Barclay, cautiously hopeful, cradles his old fashioned and glances toward the door as if the month might actually leave.
turn: THEFT - a monthly average filed as a quota, met on day one

title: Edition B07 (Duo)
caption: BARCLAY: "I'm holding out for a five percent mortgage. We close Friday at six point six six."
tv: MORTGAGE RATES CLIMB AS HIKE BETS GROW
tvPicture: A two-story colonial house behind a trimmed lawn, front door shut.
board: HAPPY HOUR 4-7 / LOCKED THIRTY YEARS / $14, PLUS POINTS
action: Barclay, upbeat, raises his old fashioned as if announcing good news; Abby laughs and points the bar spoon at him in congratulation; Drew, deadpan, nudges his martini a coaster's width away from the celebration.
turn: CONTRADICTION he does not notice - holding out for five, closing Friday at 6.66; the action falsifies the claim in five words.

title: Edition A08 (Trio)
caption: DREW: "Bank of America is stressing a key level, which is refreshing after fifteen years of taking the test."
tv: BANK OF AMERICA WARNS ON S&P 500 SUPPORT
tvPicture: A bank's stone facade with tall columns and a heavy bronze door, no lettering.
board: OLD FASHIONED $18 / SUGAR HELD IN RESERVE / WELL CAPITALIZED
action: Drew, deadpan, bill slightly parted, lowers his martini onto the exact centre of its coaster like a man setting a level; Barclay, earnest, squints at the screen and then at the waterline of his own old fashioned.
turn: COLLISION on 'stress' - the bank that has sat the stress test since 2009 finally gets to administer one; the reader assembles 'stress test' himself.

title: Edition A05 (Trio)
caption: BARCLAY: "Oil went through ninety-five this morning, and I'm long exactly one tank of regular."
tv: OIL TOPS $95 ON STRAIT OF HORMUZ TENSIONS
tvPicture: an oil tanker on open water.
board: THE FILL-UP, LAST WEEK $54 / THE FILL-UP, TUESDAY $61 / HOLDERS OF THE FORMER: STOOL TWO
action: Barclay, quietly pleased, pats the jacket pocket where his car keys are, old fashioned in the other hand; Drew, deadpan, raises his martini in a small toast.
turn: COLLISION on long - a full tank filed as the day's only winning position

title: Edition A10 (Trio)
caption: DREW: "The Dow lost eight-tenths today, its September average to the decimal - somebody did the reading."
tv: SEPTEMBER: HISTORICALLY WALL STREET'S WORST MONTH
tvPicture: A wall calendar with one page freshly turned over, its squares blank.
board: FALL SURPRISE $16 / DISCONTINUED 1950 / ASK ABOUT OCTOBER
action: Drew, deadpan, bill slightly parted, tips his martini a quarter-inch toward the screen without taking his eyes off it; Barclay, earnest and faintly pained, cups his old fashioned in both paws
turn: PROMOTION - a decline that lands on the historical average to the decimal is promoted into diligence: the market did its homework.

title: Edition B01 (Duo)
caption: BARCLAY: "Energy was today's only winner, and I'm short it through the Suburban."
tv: TEN OF ELEVEN S&P SECTORS FALL TO OPEN SEPTEMBER
tvPicture: A gas pump with its nozzle hung in the cradle, the price display blank.
board: REGULAR, FRIDAY $61 / REGULAR, TUESDAY $74 / PAY AT THE PUMP
action: Barclay, earnest and resigned, swirls the ice in his old fashioned; Drew, deadpan, studies him over the rim of his martini; Abby, laughing, tops up the nut bowl in front of Barclay with a generous shake.
turn: THEFT at wallet height - a gas bill filed as a short position; the one winning sector is the one he is on the wrong side of.

title: Edition A01 (Trio)
caption: BARCLAY: "I don't mind a rate hike. I'd just like two years of waiting for a cut counted as time served."
tv: MARKETS NOW PRICE RATE HIKES, NOT CUTS
tvPicture: A row of empty chairs in a waiting room under a plain wall clock.
board: EASING $9 - DISCONTINUED 2024 / TIGHTENING - MARKET PRICE / NO SUBSTITUTIONS
action: Barclay, resigned but pleasant, turns his old fashioned a quarter-turn on its coaster; Drew, amused, lifts his martini an inch in salute to the request.
turn: THEFT - two years of waiting on the Fed filed as a prison sentence; the Cheerful Concession grants the cost and asks for credit.

title: Edition A04 (Trio)
caption: BARCLAY: "I own Nvidia, Broadcom and Marvell, so this is the first tariff I've paid before anything shipped."
tv: CHIP STOCKS SLIDE ON NEW CHINA, TAIWAN TARIFFS
tvPicture: a bare green circuit board with one large square chip.
board: THE SEMICONDUCTOR $22 / COLLECTED AT THE RAIL / GOODS TO FOLLOW
action: Barclay, rueful, taps the edge of his coaster like a card reader while his old fashioned sits untouched; Drew, deadpan, nudges the nut bowl toward him as if delivering the goods, martini steady in his other wing.
turn: COLLISION on paid - the tariff debits his brokerage before customs sees a chip

title: Edition A09 (Trio)
caption: DREW: "Rates remain paused in concept, rising in operations."
tv: FED STANDS PAT AS YIELDS, MORTGAGES JUMP
tvPicture: An empty escalator in a marble lobby, stopped.
board: FIXED $9 / FLOATING $9 / TIDE CHARTS ON REQUEST
action: Drew states it to the middle distance, martini balanced on his wing; Barclay looks from the TV to his old fashioned and back, uneasy, both hands around the glass.
turn: CONTRADICTION in two balanced clauses - the Status Report: paused, yet rising, and the stopped escalator on the TV is literally both.

title: Edition A02 (Trio)
caption: DREW: "There's something nostalgic about watching Nvidia trade like a chip company."
tv: SEMICONDUCTOR STOCKS SLIDE ON TAIWAN TARIFF NEWS
tvPicture: a factory smokestack against a plain sky
board: THE MOAT $31 - DRAINED / REFILL DUE: NEXT EARNINGS
action: Drew, wistful for exactly one second, tilts his martini toward the screen; Barclay, puzzled, peers into his old fashioned as though the answer sank.
turn: EMOTIONAL MISFILE - nostalgia attached to a demotion; 'chip company' is the demotion.

title: Edition A06 (Trio)
caption: BARCLAY: "We all complain September is the worst month and then we sell on the first."
tvPicture: a bare tree dropping its first leaves onto an empty sidewalk
board: OLD FASHIONED, AUGUST $16 / OLD FASHIONED, NOW $15.87 / SEASONAL ADJUSTMENT SINCE 1950
action: Barclay, earnest and a little rueful, turns his old fashioned a quarter-turn on its coaster; Drew, deadpan, watches the television and lifts his martini an inch.
turn: PRACTICE SWING - the complaint about September and the selling on the first are the same act, speaker included.
